# Third-party logos

`public/logos/` contains logos of AI assistants and marketing tools that Aeon monitors or integrates with.
They are shown only to identify those products ("tracks answers across…", "works with…").

- AI engine logos and wordmarks: [LobeHub Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons) (`@lobehub/icons-static-svg` 1.95.1), MIT License.
- Semrush and Google Search Console: [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) 16.32.0, CC0 1.0.

All product names, logos and brands are the property of their respective owners. Use does not imply endorsement.
